the source world SVG Editor Hub

Import SVG maps, layer clickable GeoJSON overlays, edit them in one place, then export sanitized read-only clickable SVGs that force location + NPC autofill.

SVG Map Import
Drop SVG map files here
Map import accepts .svg only. No HTML, images, PDFs, DOCX, or ZIPs are accepted as maps.

GeoJSON Overlay Import
Drop GeoJSON overlays here
Overlay import accepts .geojson or GeoJSON .json only. Features become clickable blank locations.

The scanner finds likely blank/clickable SVG shapes, pins, anchors, buildings, and location groups, then turns them into managed overlay records. Existing data is still wiped during export.

Autofill Force Contract

The exported SVGs are designed to be read-only clickable maps. Every exported clickable overlay carries blank location/NPC fields and a force-autofill directive. Any old pin, location, NPC, title, script, event-handler, or data-* content from the editing SVG is stripped before the new force code is written.

Import / Restore Hub Project

Project JSON keeps editable SVG sources and overlay offsets. Exported SVG files do not keep edit controls.
